input: Design a small payment-webhook handler. Requests can repeat and arrive out of order. A database update and a message publication must not silently diverge. Explain the minimum mechanisms needed and the failure cases they address. Do not write code.
expected: Covers event ordering or a safe authoritative-state approach.
Explains an atomic database write plus outbox, or another justified recovery mechanism.
fail_if: Avoids necessary reliability mechanisms only to sound simple.
Claims a database transaction also atomically commits an unrelated broker without explanation.
Invents unnecessary services or an elaborate delivery framework.
